plan.title: Live single-stage RFQ with two invited vendors

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation and keep Publish available.
Set the event type to RFQ and award the entire lot to one vendor.
Set the title required for publishing and later identification.
Apply the first offered RFQ pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Add the specified product and set its requested quantity to 10.
Complete the pricing sheet fields required for the RFQ.
Set the first line item's delivery location to the specified plant.
Invite exactly two QA test vendors without inventing supplier names.
Commit a 24-hour equivalent schedule starting now.
Confirm the browser reached the published project page.
Verify the published project page shows the live state.
Verify that neither of the two invited vendors has submitted a bid.
